kyoto_gion_negiyaki_kana.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: negiyaki, betayaki, okonomiyaki and yakisoba are wheat-batter or wheat-noodle dishes cooked on one shared teppan with sauce or soy sauce (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_negiyaki_kana.vegan_detail: Not vegan: fillings are beef tendon, pork, squid and chikuwa, the dashimaki is egg and dashi, and the batter dishes carry egg or meat (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_gion_negiyaki_kana.hours_raw: Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Sunday 12:00–22:00 (last order 21:30); Friday and Saturday 12:00–3:00 (last order 2:00); closed Monday and the 1st and 3rd Tuesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended; two-hour limit (Tabelog); some walk-ins get seats, others find it full (2026 reviews). Each pancake takes a while on the teppan (2026 reviews). 12 counter seats around the teppan; non-smoking; cash only (Tabelog). On Higashioji-dori opposite the Tsukimicho post office, southwest of Yasaka Shrine; 8 min walk from Exit 6 of Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_gion_negiyaki_kana.notes: [Negiyaki · Gion, a teppan counter by Yasaka Shrine] A 12-seat counter on Higashioji-dori near Yasaka Shrine, founded in 1984 per a reviewer, where the owner cooks on the teppan in front of you and chats with the regulars along the counter. Order the negiyaki — thin batter under a heap of green onion, with soy sauce (¥800 with pork) — or the Kyoto betayaki with its spicy sauce, and start with the special dashimaki rolled on the griddle with pickled ginger (¥650) while you wait. Book ahead; two-hour limit; cash only. Open until 3:00 on Friday and Saturday; closed Monday.

roles: Owner-cook at the teppan (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: An October 2026 reviewer gives the founding year as 1984, and another that month calls it a teppan-yaki restaurant with over 40 years of history. Reviewers describe the owner cooking at the teppan and chatting with customers, the owner’s homemade potato salad and simmered whelk, and a counter of regulars. Tabelog Okonomiyaki "Tabelog 100" 2018, 2019, 2022–2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Negiyaki; betayaki; dashimaki.

anecdotes.text: "The owner was friendly and struck up a conversation, which made me feel welcome." — September 2026.
An October 2026 diner ordered beef tendon with daikon that never came, and had the recommended potato salad instead.
"I also learned the proper way to enjoy it, which was quite educational!" — September 2026.
A November 2026 diner who could not get a booking peeked in and found two seats free at the end of the counter.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: お好み焼き・鉄板焼き、東山区東大路安井北門通月見町13、京阪祇園四条駅6番出口から東大路通を南へ、月見町郵便局の向かい、徒歩8分、火水木日 12:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:30)、金土 12:00〜3:00 (L.O. 2:00)、月曜と第1・第3火曜休み、予約可、2時間制、カウンター12席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、お好み焼き百名店 2018・2019・2022〜2025。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 1984年創業、ねぎ焼 (豚800円、ミックス、卵 +100円)、ベタ焼ミックス1,000円、特製だし巻650円 (ねぎと紅しょうが)、ポテトサラダ500円、とんぺい焼、牛すじ、店主の手作りのつぶ貝の煮物、常連の多いカウンター、現金のみ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; order at the counter; the owner explains how to eat each dish; cash only.

existence.note: Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026; Okonomiyaki Tabelog 100 2025.

kyoto_fleur_de_farine.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat bakery of French breads, sandwiches and filled rolls (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fleur_de_farine.vegan_detail: Ask. Plain French breads and bean breads exist, but most items are savoury breads with cheese, bacon, egg, mayonnaise or beef, or sweet breads with custard; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_fleur_de_farine.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–19:00; closed Sunday and Monday (Tabelog). Takeaway only; the shop is small and feels full with two or three customers (2026 reviews). Some breads sell out by the afternoon (September 2026). No reservations; cash only (Tabelog). On Higashinotoin-dori south of Sanjo, near Rokkakudo; 3 min walk from Karasuma Oike Stn (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_fleur_de_farine.notes: [Bakery · Karasuma Oike, savoury breads at old prices] A tiny Paris-looking bakery on Higashinotoin-dori, a few minutes from Karasuma Oike, whose shelves are packed with savoury breads that reviewers cannot believe are so cheap: three items with change from ¥1,000. Try the croque monsieur (¥280), the cheese-filled Fromage, a beef cutlet sandwich (¥370) or the sweet five-bean French bread (¥220). Takeaway only, cash only; two or three customers fill it. Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–19:00.

roles: Bakery; no owner or baker is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: Reviewers in 2026 describe a very small shop with a Parisian look, shelves packed with mostly savoury breads, and prices low for the times. A September 2026 visitor found the name FLEUR DE FARINE hard to read on the front. Tabelog Bread WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Savoury breads; croque monsieur; five-bean French bread.

anecdotes.text: "You can buy three items and still get change from JPY 1000, which is quite a blessing in these times." — October 2026.
"I wish they had the name "FLEUR DE FARINE" written prominently, as I struggled to read it" — September 2026.
An October 2026 buyer named the ¥370 beef cutlet sandwich the star of the bag.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: パン・サンドイッチ、中京区東洞院通三条下ル三文字町200 ミックナカムラビル1F、烏丸御池駅から305m、火〜土 11:00〜19:00、日・月休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、パン WEST 百名店 2022・2026。口コミ (2026年8〜10月): 六角堂近くのこじんまりした店、5種の豆のフランスパン220円 (9月の口コミでは216円)、ベーコンとチーズのフランスパン240円、英語の口コミ: クロックムッシュ280円、カマンベールクリーム220円、牛カツサンド370円、フランスあんパン140円、総菜パン中心、2〜3人でいっぱいの小さな店、安い。

cultural_comfort.note: Small takeaway shop; cash only.

kyoto_yuzugen_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. The yuzu hot pots finish with noodles or rice porridge, and the menu adds gyoza, noodle bowls and fried chicken; the broth ingredients are not published (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yuzugen_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but every hot pot on the menu is wagyu, sea bream, shrimp, pork or chicken, and the gyoza filling is not described as meat-free (Tabelog; official menu).
kyoto_yuzugen_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 (last order 21:00); closed Tuesday; hours may change with weather or season (Tabelog). The operator’s own page also lists lunch 11:30–14:00 (last order) — not on Tabelog, so check. Bookings by phone or Tabelog only (not via Auto Reserve); two-hour seating; ¥3,000 a head for same-day cancellation or no-show; a service charge is added (Tabelog). One-drink policy and QR ordering (December 2025). 48 seats: a counter downstairs, tatami rooms up a steep staircase; restroom on the first floor only (Tabelog; October 2026). Cards, IC cards and QR payments; non-smoking (Tabelog). Takeaway and Uber Eats (official site). On Pontocho, north of Shijo; 2 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yuzugen_pontocho.notes: [Yuzu hot pot · Pontocho, a townhouse full of citrus] A small renovated townhouse on Pontocho, open since 2005, where almost everything carries yuzu: hot pots of sea bream, shrimp, pork, chicken or wagyu in a tart yuzu broth (from ¥2,800 a head, finished with noodles or porridge), yuzu-shaped gyoza in green and yellow versions, and yuzu sakes. Counter downstairs, tatami rooms up a steep stair. Dinner 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesday; book through Tabelog or by phone.

roles: Run by KIWA Corporation (際コーポレーション); kitchen staff unnamed
chef_bio.background: Opened 16 July 2005 (Tabelog). One of the many restaurant brands of KIWA Corporation (際コーポレーション), whose brand list links 柚子元 to this Pontocho shop only (official site). A December 2025 reviewer who has eaten here since it opened said the taste is unchanged.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the operator: a small, cute townhouse in historic Pontocho where yuzu dishes and drinks soothe with their scent — "a drink at a fair price, and a full stomach" (official site).
chef_bio.specialty: Yuzu nabe; yuzu gyoza.

anecdotes.text: "The taste has remained unchanged since the opening!" — December 2025; the same regular noted mostly foreign customers in June 2026.
With one burner per table of four, a March 2026 diner advised ordering a pot each and not overcooking the sea bream.
An April 2026 visitor found the meal "just okay", the yuzu broth reminiscent of a Taiwanese sour-cabbage hot pot, while the yuzu dumplings were the highlight.
Steep stairs to the second floor worried a couple with knee trouble, though the staff were very pleasant — January 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kiwa-group.co.jp): 柚子元 先斗町、柚子を使った料理やお酒、歴史ある花街先斗町の京町家を改装した小さくてかわいらしい店、1階はカウンター、2階はお座敷、11:30〜14:00 L.O.・17:00〜22:00 (21:00 L.O.)、火曜定休、48席、個室あり、カード・QR・電子マネー可、禁煙、テイクアウト・UberEats、中京区先斗町四条上る鍋屋町212。メニュー (2025年3月、税込): 柚子鍋 (一人前、二人前より) 黒毛和牛柚子しゃぶ4,800円・海老と鯛柚子鍋3,300円・鯛柚子鍋3,000円・豚柚子鍋2,800円・鶏柚子鍋2,800円、柚子麺1,380〜1,800円、青柚子餃子・黄柚子餃子 (8ケ1,000円・6ケ750円・4ケ500円)、鯛油淋、鶏唐揚、柚子キャベツ、たたき胡瓜、柚子酒。食べログ: 中華料理・鍋・居酒屋、17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00)、火曜休み、席は2時間制、当日キャンセル・無断キャンセルは1人3,000円、サービス料あり、ベジタリアンメニューあり、2005年7月16日オープン。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 豚柚子鍋、鯛の鍋、柚子餃子2種、締めの麺と雑炊、急な階段、外国からの客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: QR ordering; book via Tabelog or phone; two-hour seating; tatami upstairs.

kyoto_pontocho_asari.gf_detail: Ask. The house hot pot is soy-sauce based, and the menu includes tempura, sushi and fried eel rolls; no gluten information (2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_asari.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options and there are yuba, nama-fu and vegetable obanzai, but obanzai such as eggplant in dashi are made with broth, and the hot pot holds pork, offal and clams (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_pontocho_asari.hours_raw: Monday–Friday 15:00–2:00, Saturday and Sunday 12:00–2:00, open every day (Tabelog). Bookings via Tabelog, even on the day; parties of two sit at the counter; large groups may be sent to an annex nearby (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews). Courses with all-you-can-drink from about ¥5,000–6,000 (2025–26 reviews; Tabelog). A March 2026 reviewer was charged 10% service at night. 78 seats, private rooms for 6 to 30+, private hire for 20–50; heated-tobacco area only; cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Second floor on Pontocho, about 1 min north of Shijo; 3 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_pontocho_asari.notes: [Izakaya · Pontocho, obanzai and hot pot until 2 am] A large, bright second-floor izakaya on Pontocho with Japanese umbrellas hanging from the ceiling, open from mid-afternoon (noon at weekends) to 2:00 every day: Kyoto obanzai like yuba sashimi and eggplant in dashi, a pork-offal-and-clam hot pot, and Kyoto and Shiga sake, mostly as all-you-can-drink courses (¥5,000–6,000). Easy to book even on the day. Reviews are mixed; many guests are tourists.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Opened 1 May 2022 (Tabelog). Per the operator’s Tabelog text: a casual izakaya for first-timers, with seasonal Kyoto vegetables, obanzai such as yuba and nama-fu, and local sake from Kyoto and Shiga.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai courses; asari and horumon hot pot.

anecdotes.text: A party of 11 got a last-minute Friday booking; the yuba was the highlight, the only downside bottled beer — June 2025.
A March 2025 diner found the dishes over-seasoned and the drinks hastily made.
A March 2026 reviewer reported a 10% night service charge, a clogged soy-sauce dispenser and staff who did not name the dishes.
A group of 15 that booked a "fully private room" was sent to another location and seated in a space other guests could enter — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 先斗町 あさり、居酒屋・もつ鍋・日本料理、中京区鍋屋町213 2F、四条先斗町から北へ徒歩約1分、月〜金 15:00〜2:00、土日 12:00〜2:00、年中無休、2名の予約はカウンター席、78席、個室あり、貸切20〜50人、加熱式たばこのみ喫煙可、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、2022年5月1日オープン、京野菜、湯葉や生麩のおばんざい、京都と滋賀の地酒、飲み放題付きおばんざいと握り寿司のコース6,000円、ベジタリアンメニューあり。口コミ (2025年1月〜2026年9月、英語): 生湯葉、もつ鍋 (豚、ホルモン、あさり、醤油ベース)、雑炊、飲み放題付き京のおばんざい10品コース5,000円、夜はサービス料10%、別館の個室、観光客が多い。

cultural_comfort.note: Book on Tabelog; courses with all-you-can-drink are the easy order.

existence.note: Tabelog listing (operator text and courses); reviews dated through September 2026.

kyoto_petit_restaurant_naitou.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: the menu is built on breaded cutlets (tonkatsu, beef cutlet, ham cutlet, fried shrimp, croquettes), demi-glace stews and curry; no gluten information (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_petit_restaurant_naitou.vegan_detail: Not vegan: every main is pork, beef, seafood or chicken, and the salads carry house ham, bacon, meatloaf or pork (official menu).
kyoto_petit_restaurant_naitou.hours_raw: Since September 2026: 13:00–21:00 straight through (last order 20:30); closed Monday (official site; November 2026 calendar). 13:00–16:00: one drink per person (coffee or tea after the meal counts), à la carte, plus the Naitou special plate until 15:00, ten a day; from 16:00: one drink and a seasonal otsukidashi ¥800 (table charge) (official site). The lunch set menu ended in August 2026; Tabelog still shows the old lunch/dinner split. Bookings preferred, by phone (official site). 25 seats with a 5-seat bar counter; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). On Fuyacho-dori north of Oshikoji, 5 min from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (official site; Tabelog).
kyoto_petit_restaurant_naitou.notes: [Yoshoku · south of the Imperial Palace, tonkatsu and seasonal plates] A small, red-carpeted western-style restaurant on Fuyacho run by its owner since 2001 (first an eight-seat counter in Kawaramachi-Sanjo): crisp tonkatsu and creative cutlets, a dense wagyu hamburg steak, beef cutlet and demi-glace stews. Since September 2026 it runs straight through 13:00–21:00 with a one-drink rule; before 15:00 try the Naitou plate (¥2,900, ten a day). Book by phone. Closed Monday.

roles: Owner (店主, official site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in 2001 as an eight-seat, four-tsubo counter at Kawaramachi-Sanjo, when the owner was 33; moved to Yanagibaba-dori south of the palace in 2004 and to Fuyacho-dori in 2019 (December 2019, per Tabelog). From September 2026 the lunch sets ended and the shop switched to straight-through hours. Tabelog Yoshoku WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Tonkatsu; wagyu hamburg steak; Naitou special plate.

anecdotes.text: Beef cutlet ¥3,300, Australian top sirloin cooked medium-rare, with a generous tonjiru — August 2026.
A July 2026 family party found the host adjusted the à la carte portions for sharing so it felt like a course.
A November 2026 diner paid over ¥4,000 for the plate set and a juice and found the hamburg steak firmer than hoped.
The room has a deep red carpet and curtains, wooden tables and European decorations: three tables for four, one for five and about four counter seats — September 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (petitrestaurant-naito.com): 季節の料理&とんかつのお店、2001年 河原町三条にカウンター8席4坪で開業 (33歳)、2004年 御所南・柳馬場通りに移転、2019年 御所南・麩屋町通りに移転、店主 内藤毅彦、2026年9月から通し営業 13時〜21時 (20時30分 L.O)、13時〜16時はワンドリンク制 (食後のコーヒー紅茶可)、16時からはワンドリンク制と季節のおつきだし800円 (テーブルチャージ)、ランチセットメニューは2026年8月末で終了、ご予約優先、定休日 月曜日、ないとうスペシャルプレート (1日10食、13時〜15時): ヒレトンカツ、ハンバーグ、エビフライ、豚しゃぶサラダ、グリーンサラダ、プレートのみ2,900円・ご飯と豚汁セット3,500円、メニュー: ロースとんかつ、ゴルゴンゾーラポークカツ、生姜と大葉のミルフィーユサンドカツ、ピザカツ、自家製ハムカツ、トンテキ、天然鯛のカレーライス、海老と蟹のクリームコロッケ、牡蠣フライ (季節)、和牛ハンバーグステーキ、黒毛和牛三角バラのビーフシチュー、中京区尾張町217 サンロータス池治1F。食べログ: 洋食・とんかつ・ハンバーグ、25席、禁煙、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、洋食 WEST 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年10月〜2026年11月、英語): ビーフカツ3,300円、ないとうプレート、豚汁、ハンバーグ。

cultural_comfort.note: Book by phone; one drink per person; ¥800 starter charge after 16:00.

existence.note: Official site (October 2026 notices, December calendar) and Tabelog listing; reviews dated through November 2026.

kyoto_kyogashi_shojuken.gf_detail: Ask. Mochi and bean-paste sweets such as botamochi and warabi mochi may suit, but the Mikasa is a small dorayaki (a baked batter cake) and the monaka has a wafer shell; no ingredient list is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyogashi_shojuken.vegan_detail: Ask. Bean-paste and mochi sweets such as botamochi, warabi mochi and monaka may suit, but the Mikasa batter and the other sweets have no published ingredient list (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyogashi_shojuken.hours_raw: No fixed hours published. Tabelog (operator text): reservation-only, and "currently closed all day" for renovation while taking phone orders; seasonal fresh wagashi must be ordered by the day before; walk-in sales happen but booked orders come first and items sell out. Reviewers bought over the counter through November 2026, mostly between 11:00 and 15:00; a November 2026 reviewer says it opens at 11:00, not 10:00 as some sites say. Book by phone (075-561-4030) a day or more ahead. Cash only; non-smoking (Tabelog; June 2026). Room for about five inside (October 2026). On a narrow lane west of Yamato-oji on Matsubara-dori, near Kenninji; 6 min from Kiyomizu-Gojo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyogashi_shojuken.notes: [Wagashi · Kenninji, a temple supplier in a back lane] A tiny wagashi shop on a quiet lane by Kenninji, supplier to Kenninji and Kodaiji: the small dorayaki called Mikasa (¥180), a monaka filled after you order so the shell stays crisp (¥180), and seasonal fresh sweets from ¥300. Phone ahead — booked orders come first, and fresh sweets need a day's notice; walk-ins often find things sold out. Tabelog says it is under renovation and taking phone orders. Cash only.

roles: Owner (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the operator’s Tabelog text: founded in 1932; a favourite of Kenninji since its founding and, by reputation, also a supplier to Kodaiji; trusted by Gion teahouses. A March 2026 reviewer gives 2026 as its 94th year; a November 2026 reviewer gives the founding as 1927. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026, Sweets WEST 2018–2020 and 2022, Sweets 2017.
chef_bio.specialty: Mikasa; monaka; seasonal jō-namagashi.

anecdotes.text: Without a booking at 11:30, a March 2026 visitor was told the Mikasa was not ready and came back at 14:30; dried sweets were given free.
Customers who came after a May 2026 reviewer without a booking found the products sold out.
"The monaka is filled with sweet red bean paste right after you order it" — February 2026.
A March 2026 reviewer heard the shop is a favourite of Kenninji and was patronised by Nene, wife of Toyotomi Hideyoshi.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: 京菓子司 松寿軒、和菓子・どら焼き、東山区松原通大和大路西入弓矢町19-12、清水五条駅から徒歩6分、予約優先 (来店時は売り切れの場合あり)、現在は終日休業で改装中だが電話予約は可能、上生菓子は前日までに要連絡、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、禁煙、1932年創業、建仁寺御用達、高台寺にも納める、祇園のお茶屋さん、和菓子・甘味処 WEST 百名店 2023・2026、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2018〜2020・2022、スイーツ百名店 2017。口コミ (2026年2〜11月、英語): Mikasa (小さなどら焼き) 180円、注文後にあんを詰める最中180円、季節の上生菓子300〜360円、ぼたもち200円、わらび餅350円、土用餅、開店は11時、1927年創業とする口コミも。

cultural_comfort.note: Phone ahead to reserve sweets; small counter shop; cash only.

kyoto_ichiya_beer_pub.gf_detail: Not gluten-free in practice: a craft-beer pub (beer is barley or wheat) whose food includes zeppole (fried bread), croquettes, pizza and ravioli; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, October 2026; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_ichiya_beer_pub.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, and olives, smoked nuts, sauerkraut, green salad, grilled black-soybean edamame and fries are on the menu, but nothing is marked vegan (Tabelog menu, October 2026).
kyoto_ichiya_beer_pub.hours_raw: 17:00–22:00 Monday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday; 12:00–22:00 Saturday, Sunday and holidays (and on Tuesdays that are holidays); closed Tuesday (Tabelog). Renovated and renamed from BEER PUB ICHI-YA, with a new, more food-led Italian menu (March 2026). Bookings taken; over 9 people by phone (Tabelog). An appetizer is served: one May 2026 reviewer calls it complimentary, another paid ¥300 each. 43 seats (counter, round tables, a large table, wall counter); non-smoking, with a smoking area outside; cards, e-money and QR; English menu and English-speaking staff; children welcome (Tabelog). 3 min walk north from exit 9 of Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog). Opened 8 August 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_ichiya_beer_pub.notes: [Craft beer & Italian · Nishiki, Ichijoji Brewery's pub] Ichijoji Brewery's taproom just north of Nishiki Market, renovated in 2026 with an Italian menu: beers from Belgian wheat to a yuzu weiss and an English-style IPA, then Kyoto yuba potato salad, spare ribs stewed in the brewery's own beer, octopus in red wine, wagyu tagliata. A three-beer, three-dish tasting set (¥2,500) is the easy way in. Reviewers like the beer and the panna cotta; two found the high chairs uncomfortable, and some found the prices on the high side. English menu. Open from noon at weekends; closed Tuesday.

roles: Pub of Ichijoji Brewery (Kyoto); no person is named
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists the former name BEER PUB ICHI-YA; a March 2026 regular found it renovated, the menu much more food-led and the Red Ale gone. Reviewers describe it as the pub of Kyoto’s Ichijoji Brewery (December 2025; May 2026), and a November 2025 reviewer refers to a second location. Opened 8 August 2016 (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Ichijoji Brewery craft beer; beer-stewed spare ribs; tasting set.

anecdotes.text: A December 2025 diner liked the beers and a light Kyoto-style oden on the old menu but found the chairs uncomfortable.
A March 2026 regular found many international customers and a lively rather than quiet room after the renovation.
An October 2026 solo diner on the all-you-can-drink course wished the busy kitchen had paced the dishes more slowly.

kyoto_uzuraya_shijo.gf_detail: Ask. Chicken sashimi comes with sesame oil, ponzu or yuzu pepper, and the grills and oyakodon use sauces and dashi; no gluten information is published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_uzuraya_shijo.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a chicken and quail house; grilled vegetables are on the menu, but the soup is chicken and the oyakodon uses dashi (2026 reviews).
kyoto_uzuraya_shijo.hours_raw: 17:30–22:00; Thursday 18:00–22:00; closed Wednesday; hours may change (Tabelog). Usually fully booked: book online through Pocket Concierge (Tabelog) or phone; walk-ins are sometimes offered a one-hour slot or a later time (August–September 2026). Serves chicken sashimi (raw and rare chicken: sasami, gizzard, white liver, heart, kombu-cured breast) (July–October 2026). 10 counter seats; non-smoking; cards (Tabelog). On the east side of Kawabata-dori just north of Shijo, by the Kamo River; 122 m from Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026).
kyoto_uzuraya_shijo.notes: [Chicken · Shijo Kawabata, a 10-seat chicken counter by the Kamo River] A narrow ten-seat counter on Kawabata-dori just north of Shijo, where the master grills chicken and quail over charcoal and serves it off the skewer in bite-size pieces. Start with the chicken sashimi — white liver with sesame oil, heart, kombu-cured breast — or the rare thigh tataki; then quail thigh, gizzard, red liver and grilled vegetables such as Kamo eggplant; finish with an oyakodon soaked in dashi. Good sake, including Aramasa. Almost always full: book, or ask for an hour's slot. Bills ran about ¥6,000–15,000 a head in 2026. Closed Wednesday.

roles: Master (主) at the grill, with young staff (August 2026); not named
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 Japanese review: the master holds the grill at the far end of the long counter and young staff work briskly under the master’s direction; the cooking is not on skewers, and the heat is well managed; the staff came to call the reviewer, who had arrived early and was waiting by the Kamo River. A regular of ten years (January 2024) and others describe it as always booked. Tabelog Chicken "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Chicken sashimi (white liver); thigh tataki; oyakodon.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 regular phoned at 17:56, was offered seats for one hour, and noticed many overseas visitors asking to come in without a booking.
An October 2026 diner ordered the grilled white liver, and the next guest was told it had sold out.
A May 2025 regular brought a cheesecake and asked the kitchen to recreate it; it might be added to the dessert menu.
A May 2026 diner found the counter a bit cramped for larger people, but the atmosphere inviting.

kyoto_star_bar.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail bar: drinks, kakigori with matcha, yuzu or fermented-milk syrups, smoked nuts and dried fruit; no gluten information is published (Tabelog menu, April 2026).
kyoto_star_bar.vegan_detail: Ask. The kakigori comes with matcha, yuzu and fermented-milk syrups (the last is dairy); smoked nuts and dried fruit are the only food (Tabelog menu, April 2026).
kyoto_star_bar.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last drink order 23:00) every day, with irregular closures — check by phone or Google Maps on the day (Tabelog). In summer it is a kakigori shop by day (official site); a reviewer found it opening at 14:00 (August 2026). Table charge ¥2,200, waived before 19:00 (Tabelog; August 2026). Groups of three or more must book (Tabelog). Card and cashless payment only, no cash (Tabelog; September 2026). 12 seats (8 at the counter, one table for 4); fully non-smoking, no heated tobacco, ashtray outside; free Wi-Fi (Tabelog). In an alley off Kiyamachi south of Sanjo, between Pontocho and Kiyamachi; 4 min walk from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; August 2026). Opened 11 July 2016 (Tabelog).
kyoto_star_bar.notes: [Bar & kakigori · Kiyamachi, Ginza's Star Bar in a Kyoto alley] The Kyoto branch of Ginza's Star Bar, down an alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho: a dim, Japanese-styled room with a tea set at its centre, where the kimono-clad master works alone. Everything turns on ice — hand-cut clear ice for highballs, and the bar's own 洛氷 from Kyoto spring water, shaved into kakigori (¥2,500) with matcha whisked at the counter or yuzu syrup. Come before 19:00 to skip the ¥2,200 table charge. Cocktails run ¥2,000–3,000. Cards only. One May 2026 visitor found the charge poor value and the staff absorbed in a computer.

roles: Owner (the invoice holder); a May 2026 review describes the master, in a kimono, managing everything solo
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog: a directly managed shop of STAR BAR GINZA in Ginza 1-chome, Tokyo. Per the official site: four STAR BAR shops (Ginza, Namiki, Kyoto, Hibiya Midtown); Star Bar made ice the star of the bar, uses three kinds of ice frozen in different ways, and the Kyoto shop makes craft ice (洛氷) from Kyoto spring waters under the only ice-making licence in Kyoto city; by day in summer the Kyoto shop is a kakigori shop. The invoice register lists an individual, 松田 高雅, for the Kyoto shop’s invoice number. Tabelog Bar "Tabelog 100" 2022. Opened 11 July 2016.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: hand-cut ice is pursued for function as well as beauty, down to water quality and the theory of freezing.
chef_bio.specialty: Kakigori of 洛氷; matcha cocktails; hand-cut ice.

anecdotes.text: "I had a delightful time with the master, who was dressed in a kimono." — May 2026.
An August 2026 visitor watched the owner grind matcha at the counter and pour it over the kakigori, and was told to add it gradually with a spoon.
A May 2026 visitor took part in a tea-ceremony experience at the counter.
A May 2026 visitor felt the ¥2,200 charge brought no service and found the staff engrossed in computer work.

kyoto_koe_donuts.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: a wheat donut shop — the crullers use organic whole-wheat flour (September 2026) — fried in rice oil (September 2026); the morning plate is French toast (Tabelog menu, September 2026).
kyoto_koe_donuts.vegan_detail: Ask. The official site lists a plant-based dough among its donut types, but no ingredient list is published; the cruller uses Miyama milk and free-range eggs, and the dango donuts buttercream and chocolate (official site; Tabelog menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_koe_donuts.hours_raw: 8:00–20:00 every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog; official site). Morning plate 8:00–11:00, brunch plate 11:00–15:00, both limited each day (Tabelog menu). No reservations: find a seat first, then pay at the counter (November 2026). Popular items can sell out by evening (September 2026). 65 seats plus standing; non-smoking; cards, e-money and QR; free Wi-Fi and power outlets; children welcome; takeaway (Tabelog). On Shinkyogoku just north of Shijo, 1 min from exit 9 of Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (official site). Opened 21 March 2019 (Tabelog).
kyoto_koe_donuts.notes: [Donuts & café · Shinkyogoku, organic donuts under bamboo baskets] A large donut factory-café a minute from Kawaramachi Station, under a dome of 572 traditional hexagon-weave bamboo baskets designed by Kengo Kuma's office. The koe brand fries its donuts in rice oil from organic and natural ingredients: try the plain koe donut (¥260) or the wasanbon cruller to take away, or sit down for a 'donut melt' eaten with knife and fork (from ¥1,100). Seasonal dango donuts change with the season. From 8:00 there's a French-toast morning plate, or a ¥500 coffee-and-donut set. Spacious, with Wi-Fi and outlets. Daily 8:00–20:00.

roles: koe brand café; Tabelog gives Stripe International’s PR department as the press contact; no person is named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: an experiential donut factory serving freshly made donuts with knife and fork; ingredients chosen by three keywords, organic, natural origin and local production, made by hand in the shop as far as possible. The interior by Kengo Kuma & Associates covers a dome with 572 traditional hexagon-weave (六ツ目編み) bamboo baskets using Arashiyama bamboo; artist Yu Nagaba designed the goods, with Shun Kawakami as brand and art director. Opened 21 March 2019 (Tabelog). Tabelog Cafe WEST "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "life happens, donut helps" — new donuts for a healthy and sustainable future, with care for the environment, ingredients and production.
chef_bio.specialty: koe plain donut; wasanbon cruller; donut melt.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor came back for a second try after finding everything sold out the night before.
An October 2026 visitor waited a while for the lunch set’s soup and salad, but found the donuts crisp, chewy and not greasy.
At 9:00 on an October 2026 weekday the café was quiet, with four other groups, all apparently from the West.

kyoto_bocca_del_vino.gf_detail: Ask when booking. No gluten information; the dinner guide asks guests to mention allergies and foods they cannot eat for the omakase. Pasta is central (from ¥1,800 at lunch) and the dinner table charge includes bread; fried dishes include oysters and moroko (2025–2026 reviews; official dinner guide).
kyoto_bocca_del_vino.vegan_detail: Not vegan: the official English dinner guide (March 2026) says the restaurant does not cater for vegans.
kyoto_bocca_del_vino.hours_raw: Official blog: lunch 12:00–16:00 (last order 15:00), à la carte, at least one dish per person, no café use for dessert or drinks only; dinner last order 21:00, closing 22:00; closing days on the blog calendar, sometimes changed at short notice. A May 2026 review lists lunch on Monday, Tuesday and Sunday and dinner Wednesday–Saturday; Tabelog lists dinner every day and lunch on Monday, Tuesday and Sunday, and says lunch was limited to Monday and Tuesday from late March 2025. Closed 30 December–1 January (Tabelog). Book by phone (075-585-8267, up to two months ahead) or by email; not through Auto Reserve. Dinner table charge ¥550 per person, bread included; omakase ¥8,800 (tax and table charge included), for groups only, booked by the day before, ¥4,400 per person for same-day cancellation (official dinner guide, March 2026). 12 seats; one table for two by the counter is exposed to the weather; no river view or terrace; no smoking; no large luggage; strollers folded; children by prior arrangement; smart casual, no strong fragrance (Tabelog; official blog). Cash, cards, e-money and QR (Tabelog). 5 min walk south along Kiyamachi from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn exit 1 (Tabelog).
kyoto_bocca_del_vino.notes: [Italian · Kiyamachi, a one-cook trattoria] A 12-seat Italian on Kiyamachi south of Dango-bashi, open here since May 2015, where the chef cooks alone and dishes come to share: tomatoes and olive oil in the southern way, blackboard antipasti, pasta, venison in winter, Italian wines by the glass and bottle. Lunch is à la carte (pasta from ¥1,800); dinner adds a ¥550 table charge with bread, or an ¥8,800 omakase for groups. The restaurant asks for no hurry, says it speaks no English and does not cater for vegans. Book ahead.

roles: Chef (unnamed) who cooks alone, per the official dinner guide
chef_bio.background: Tabelog’s introduction says the ristorante opened in May 2015 for enjoying Italian wines; the blog speaks of six years of irregular closing days "after the move" (March 2021). The official English dinner guide (March 2026) says the chef cooks alone, so dishes take time and are best shared, and the restaurant cannot serve guests in a hurry. A November 2025 review explains the name as "mouth of wine" and describes a Southern-Italian trattoria of tomatoes and olive oil that does not adapt to Kyoto styles, and calls it a Bib Gourmand selection, as does a May 2026 review. A February 2025 diner praised the service of a gentle madam; an October 2026 diner, the chef’s charming manner.
chef_bio.specialty: Blackboard antipasti; southern-Italian pasta; venison.

anecdotes.text: After a kabuki show at Minami-za, a diner booked for a course was steered to à la carte so as to catch the last train — December 2024.
Of the cacio e pepe: "it was indeed quite thick, just as the customer at the next table remarked, 'It’s like udon!'" — August 2025.
A February 2025 diner heard the maritozzo, popular during the pandemic, can be made if reserved in advance; the blog (March 2021) had limited it to breakfast.
"Personally, I especially loved the roasted venison! It was topped with a persimmon sauce." — October 2026.

kyoto_stand_kiyokiyo_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The food is daily obanzai and beef tongue simmered in Kyoto-style dashi (official site); seasonings are not described.
kyoto_stand_kiyokiyo_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Tabelog lists vegetarian options, but the obanzai change daily and reviewers describe them as dashi-flavoured; some include jako or herring (August 2026).
kyoto_stand_kiyokiyo_kiyamachi.hours_raw: Tabelog: every day 14:00–22:30 (last order 22:00), closing days irregular; the official site says it opens at 14:00 for daytime drinking. kyoto_stand_kiyokiyo_kiyamachi.notes: [Standing bar · Kiyamachi, sake from 2 pm] A bright standing bar at the end of a narrow passage off Kiyamachi, open from 14:00 every day: about 20 Kyoto sakes from ¥400 (roll the dice and a glass can be ¥100 off, double, or free), obanzai at ¥300 a dish chosen from platters on the counter, and beef tongue simmered in Kyoto dashi (¥1,000). No cover charge, and there are chairs at the counter. Opened in July 2018 by the company behind the 京家きよみず izakaya; two more Kiyokiyo stands are in Sanjo and Nijo. 14:00–22:30.

roles: Standing bar of the 京家きよみず group (company not named on the site)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: opened in July 2018 as a sister shop of the izakaya 京家きよみず, which has four shops in Kyoto, with a wide range of carefully chosen Kyoto sake and Kyoto food centred on obanzai; the house dishes are beef tongue simmered for a long time in Kyoto-style dashi and the daily obanzai, and pickled ginger is served between dishes. A second stand opened on the Sanjo shopping street and a third, BiVi二条, later (official site; Tabelog). Tabelog gives the opening day as 5 July 2018.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to let people enjoy Kyoto food culture more casually and more stylishly — for a daytime drink, a quick drink or a woman drinking alone.
chef_bio.specialty: Obanzai at ¥300; dashi-simmered beef tongue; Kyoto sake.

anecdotes.text: "When I tried it, I got a discount of JPY 100 on both drinks!" — of the sake dice game, August 2026.
An August 2026 diner got eggplant, a disliked vegetable, in the omakase obanzai, but praised the dashi-simmered beef tongue and noted signage "geared towards foreigners and tourists".
"As a Kyotoite, I found all the dishes to have a nostalgic sweetness." — August 2026.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (kyoya-kiyomizu.com/kiyokiyo): 京都の立ち飲み・昼飲みにおすすめの「京都スタンド きよきよ」、祇園四条・河原町・木屋町・先斗町、京都に4店舗展開する人気居酒屋「京家きよみず」の姉妹店として木屋町は2018年7月にオープン、厳選された京の地酒、3種飲み比べ、おばんざいを中心とした京料理、果肉たっぷりのフルーツチューハイ、14時から営業、名物は京風のお出汁でじっくり炊く牛タン煮と日替わりの京おばんざい、箸休めにガリ、加熱式タバコのみ喫煙可、三条商店街と BiVi二条にも店舗。食べログ: 立ち飲み・居酒屋・日本料理、中京区木屋町通四条上ル鍋屋町220-1 FORUM木屋町先斗町ビル 1F、毎日14:00〜22:30 (L.O. 22:00)、不定休、予約可、サービス料・チャージ料なし、31席 (カウンター15、テーブル4)、カード・電子マネー・QR 可、ベジタリアンメニューあり、英語メニュー、2018年7月5日オープン。口コミ (2026年7月〜10月、英語): おばんざい各300円、おまかせ3品900円、牛タン煮1,000円、生ビール550円、レモンサワー600円、地酒400円から、チンチロ、山椒のポテトサラダ。

kyoto_yaoiso_fruit_parlour.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information. The famous fruit sandwiches are on bread; parfaits, cut fruit, fruit kanten, kuzu-arare and juices are also on the menu (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yaoiso_fruit_parlour.vegan_detail: Ask. Cut-fruit plates, fruit kanten and fresh juices are on the menu, but the sandwiches and parfaits use cream and vanilla ice cream (official menu; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_yaoiso_fruit_parlour.hours_raw: Official site: parlour 9:30–17:00 (last order 16:45); Tabelog gives every day 9:30–17:00 with last order 16:30. The fruit shop next door is open 9:00–18:00 all year except the New Year (official site). Seats cannot be booked; bookings are for takeaway only (Tabelog), and the listed phone number is the fruit shop’s (July 2025 review). A Saturday diner waited about 15 minutes at 13:00 (September 2026); morning visits found it nearly empty. 32 seats at tables and sofas; non-smoking; children welcome (Tabelog; September 2026). JCB and AMEX cards and IC cards, no QR (Tabelog). Next to Hankyu Omiya Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_yaoiso_fruit_parlour.notes: [Fruit parlour · Shijo-Omiya, the fruit sandwich] The parlour of Yaoiso, a Shijo-Omiya fruit shop founded in 1869, which added a fruit parlour in 1972 and moved it into this room next door in 2013: soft cream (lightly sweet to some reviewers, quite sweet to one) and generous seasonal fruit in soft bread (a set with mixed juice about ¥900–1,000), parfaits, and set plates of peaches or mangoes in season. Sweets WEST Tabelog 100 2026. One September 2026 diner found the fruit cut too small and the staff unfriendly. Daily 9:30–17:00; sandwiches also to take away.

roles: Parlour of the fruit shop Yaoiso (no owner named)
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: a fruit specialist founded in Meiji 2 (1869), selling gift fruit and household fruit, known for Okayama white peaches in the summer gift season and Saga Sagahonoka strawberries in winter; a fruit parlour was added in Showa 47 (1972), and its signature fruit sandwich is widely loved; a certified fruit-adviser shop, with a governor’s award as an old Kyoto business. A second shop with a parlour stands on Karasuma-dori north of Imadegawa, next to Doshisha University (official site). Tabelog gives the opening day of this parlour as 23 May 2013; a September 2026 review says it began on the second floor of the main shop in 1972 and moved here in 2013. Tabelog Sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2022, 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Fruit sandwich; seasonal fruit parfaits.

anecdotes.text: A sign advises eating the sandwich quickly because the air conditioning dries the bread — August 2026.
A September 2026 diner found even strawberries and muscat grapes cut small in the ¥1,045 parfait and the staff "not particularly friendly".
"How do they do this?" — of the soft yet firm cream in the fruit sandwich, October 2026.
A November 2026 takeaway buyer got ice packs but no guidance on how long the sandwich keeps.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 公式サイト (yaoiso.com): 創業明治2年の果物専門店、進物用の高級果物から家庭の果物まで、お中元時期の岡山直送の水蜜桃、お歳暮時期の佐賀のさがほのか苺、昭和47年にフルーツパーラーを併設、代表作「フルーツサンド」、フルーツアドバイザー認定店、京の老舗 知事賞受賞。本店 9:00〜18:00 年中無休 (年末年始を除く)、下京区四条大宮東入ル立中町488。パーラー 9:30〜17:00 (ラストオーダー 16:45)、立中町496。烏丸通今出川上ル東側 (同志社大学北隣) の店にもパーラー、10:00〜17:00、不定休。メニュー (2022年4月以降、税抜): フルーツサンドとミックスジュースのセット900円、スペシャルサンドのセット1,100円、ミニパフェセット1,250円、ロイヤルフルーツサンド1,100円、季節のフルーツパフェ1,100円、クリーム葛あられ900円、カットフルーツ1,100円、レディースセット1,000円、フルーツ寒天750円、マスクメロンパフェ1,100円、持ち帰りのフルーツサンド750円など。2025年2月から税抜50円程度の値上げ。レモンスカッシュ550円 (税込)、山形さくらんぼパフェ (四条大宮店のみ)。食べログ: フルーツパーラー・カフェ、立中町496、毎日9:30〜17:00 (L.O. 16:30)、予約はテイクアウトのみ、32席、禁煙、子供可、カード (JCB、AMEX)・電子マネー可、2013年5月23日オープン、スイーツ WEST 百名店 2022・2023・2026。口コミ (2025年7月〜2026年11月、英語): 桃づくし2,700円、マンゴーづくし2,600円、定番のフルーツパフェ1,045円、ミックスジュース、スペシャルフルーツサンド。

kyoto_sakaba_ikura_mokuzai.gf_detail: Ask. No gluten information and no printed sake menu; dishes include chicken-skin gyoza, mentaiko mochi, karinto with cream-cheese dip and conger-eel tempura alongside sashimi and charcoal-grilled fish (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaba_ikura_mokuzai.vegan_detail: Ask. The food is mostly fish and seafood; cucumber dishes and potato salad are on the menu, but nothing is said about their dressings (2026 reviews).
kyoto_sakaba_ikura_mokuzai.hours_raw: Tabelog: Monday–Saturday 17:00–22:00 (last seating and last order 21:00), closed Sundays and public holidays; hours may change. No reservations: queues form before 17:00 (about ten people at 16:30 in June 2026); in December 2025 a regular came an hour before opening for the winter crab; later in the evening there may be no wait, but dishes sell out (2025–2026 reviews). Up to three people at the counter; groups of four or more go to the outdoor tables in the lumber yard (June 2026). Counter seats non-smoking; smoking allowed in the yard seats (Tabelog). Cash only (no cards, e-money or QR) (Tabelog). No telephone (Serai 2017). About 15 min walk from Imadegawa or Marutamachi stations (June 2026).
kyoto_sakaba_ikura_mokuzai.notes: [Standing bar · Kamigyo, a lumber yard at night] By day a family lumber yard, by night a standing bar: the fourth-generation 井倉康博 turned a three-tatami office into a counter and the car park into tables (Serai 2017). Salt-seared bonito flamed outside (¥1,500), tuna and myoga rolls, grilled hamo, a ¥90 potato salad, and sake recommended out loud. A queue forms before 17:00, and the giant crab of November–December draws longer ones; popular dishes sell out. Tachinomi Tabelog 100 2025. Cash only, no bookings; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00.

roles: Owner (fourth generation of the family lumber business), per Serai 2017
chef_bio.background: Serai (5 October 2017): as the name says, the family has long made its living in the lumber trade; the fourth generation, 井倉康博 (then 40), could not give up a dream of running a restaurant, and five years earlier had opened a night-only standing bar while carrying on the family business, turning a three-tatami office into the counter and the car park into the shop; seven or eight people fit inside, and drinking outside in the autumn wind is part of the fun. Serai then listed house oil sardines (made only when large sardines come in), crab-miso ruibe ¥800, sake from ¥600 a gō, and closing on Sundays and holidays. A September 2026 diner heard that the lumber business, once run by the owner’s father, is no longer very active and the bar is now the main focus. Tabelog tachinomi "Tabelog 100" 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: Salt-seared bonito tataki; grilled hamo; winter crab.

anecdotes.text: "Don’t underestimate it because it’s a standing bar" — what regulars say, per Serai (2017).
The bonito "was cooked with flames roaring!" — October 2026.
"As for the Japanese sake, there wasn't a menu; they just explained the brands verbally." — August 2026.
An October 2026 diner ended up chatting and sharing dishes with the people at the same table.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: サライ (2017年10月5日): 酒場 井倉木材、京都市上京区、旨いものを知り尽くした客が集う立ち飲み店、かにみそのルイべ800円、自家製オイルサーディン700円 (大羽の鰯が入ったときだけ)、日本酒は1合600円〜、「立ち飲みと侮るな」と常連、ポテトサラダやするめ天、割烹にも引けをとらない旬の味、新鮮な鰹やウニは造り、肉厚しいたけは炭焼き、本来は材木業を生業としてきた家、4代目の井倉康博さん (40歳) が家業を継ぎながら5年前に夜だけの立ち飲み屋を開店、3畳の事務所を改装してカウンターに、駐車場を店舗に、店内は7〜8名、薮之内町77-1、電話なし、17時〜22時30分 (最終注文)、日曜・祝日休み。食べログ: 立ち飲み、月〜土 17:00〜22:00 (L.O. 21:00、最終入店21:00)、日・祝休み、予約不可、カード・電子マネー・QR 不可、カウンターは禁煙、倉庫の席は喫煙可、立ち飲み 百名店 2025。口コミ (2025年12月〜2026年10月、英語): 鰹の塩たたき1,500円、本マグロとみょうがの巻き1,200円、鱧の焼き霜1,800円、ポテトサラダ90円、鶏皮餃子、冬の大きな蟹、開店前の行列。

cultural_comfort.note: No sake menu — the staff name the brands out loud; queue before opening, cash only, no bookings.

kyoto_bar_rinto_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. A cocktail and whisky bar with some snacks; no gluten information (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_rinto_pontocho.vegan_detail: Ask. Drinks-first bar; no information on the snacks (2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_bar_rinto_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–2:00 every day; closed only on 1 January (Tabelog). Reservations taken; busy lately, so booking is advised, though walk-ins happen (Tabelog; March 2025). 20 seats: a 9-seat counter facing the river window, tables and a private room for 6; smoking allowed (Tabelog), and a non-smoker found the basement smoky (April 2025). Cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Cocktails about ¥1,600 (June 2026). Basement of a Pontocho building: look for the white noren and lantern, then take the stairs down (March 2025). 1 min from Gion-Shijo or Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_bar_rinto_pontocho.notes: [Bar · Pontocho, a basement counter with a Kamo River view] Under a white noren on Pontocho, stairs lead down to a long counter whose back bar faces a window onto the Kamo River — snow, cherry blossoms and, in the distance, the lights of Minami-za, depending on the night. The bar is known for "Nise Denki Bran", the fake brandy drink from Tomihiko Morimi's Kyoto novels; there are original cocktails with a house tea liqueur, the classics, whisky and cigars. Cocktails about ¥1,600. Open nightly 17:00–2:00, which makes it a late stop when Pontocho closes. Smoking allowed. A March 2025 visitor found the bartender fluent in English.

roles: Master and bartenders (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: A July 2026 reviewer learned that it is a sister bar of a bar called Nostalgia.
chef_bio.specialty: Nise Denki Bran; original cocktails with tea liqueur.

anecdotes.text: On a night of heavy snow in February 2026, a regular watched couples building snowmen on the Kamo riverbank from the counter, over a rye and soda and a gin and tonic.
"While there seemed to be many inbound customers, the bartender was fluent in English and very pleasant" — March 2025.
An April 2026 group came after dinner during cherry-blossom season and saw the blossoms along the Kamo River and, in the distance, the lights of Minami-za.
An April 2025 non-smoker found the basement smoke overwhelming, while noting the authentic atmosphere suits smokers.

chef_bio.japanese_sources_summary: 食べログ: Bar 凛ト、バー、中京区先斗町四条上ル柏屋町173-2 B1F、祇園四条駅4番出口・河原町駅1A出口から徒歩1分、毎日17:00〜2:00、1月1日のみ休み、予約可、20席 (カウンター9)、個室 (6人)、喫煙可、カード・QR 可、無料 Wi-Fi、景色・夜景。口コミ (2025〜2026年、英語): 先斗町の白い暖簾と提灯、階段を下りる、鴨川の見える窓とカウンター、Tomihiko Morimi の小説に出てくる「Nise Denki Bran」、自家製のお茶のリキュールのカクテル、カクテル約1,600円、英語が流暢なバーテンダー、Nostalgia の姉妹店。

kyoto_wasai_taka_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Fish izakaya cooking with sashimi and soy sauce, kara-age, tempura, croquettes and udon; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wasai_taka_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a fish izakaya; the buri shabu, sashimi and most small dishes are fish or meat, and yuba tofu comes in a dashi sauce (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_wasai_taka_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 16:00–1:00 (last order 0:30); closed Tuesday, but open on a Tuesday before a public holiday (Tabelog). Reservations taken, including Tabelog course bookings (January 2026). An appetizer (otoshi) is served and charged; it changes each time (Tabelog). 18 seats, counter and tables; smoking allowed (Tabelog). Cards, IC cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted (Tabelog). On the Takase River side of Kiyamachi, 3 min from Hankyu Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2024).
kyoto_wasai_taka_kiyamachi.notes: [Izakaya · Kiyamachi, buri shabu and white shrimp until 1 a.m.] A fish izakaya on the Takase River side of Kiyamachi with a handsome frontage, a counter for solo drinkers and a good sake and shochu list. Regulars never skip the white-shrimp kara-age; the other star is buri shabu-shabu, finished with Himi udon, and the ¥5,000 buri shabu course (all-you-can-drink +¥2,000, January 2026) is good value. The day's sashimi, hamo carpaccio in summer and yuba tofu round it out. One February 2025 diner found the menu narrow and portions small. Open 16:00–1:00, closed Tuesday; an otoshi is charged; smoking allowed.

roles: Owner (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Tabelog lists an invoice number for the operator but no name. A regular has eaten here six times between March and August 2025.
chef_bio.specialty: White-shrimp kara-age; buri shabu-shabu.

anecdotes.text: "The fried white shrimp was consistently good, so I ordered a second helping." — May 2025.
A November 2024 first-timer on the buri shabu course with all-you-can-drink asked whether a bone cracker could be made, and was given one on the house.
A February 2025 diner liked the crab cream croquette but found the menu limited, the portions small, and the reserved counter seat changed to a table.
"As I am from Kanazawa, this is a place I often visit when I want to enjoy sashimi." — October 2025.

kyoto_spice_gate_teramachi.gf_detail: Ask. Spice curries on basmati or long-grain rice, but the monthly specials often add katsu (pork or salmon) and the menu includes hayashi rice; no gluten information (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_spice_gate_teramachi.vegan_detail: Ask. The reviewed curries are meat or fish (mutton, katsu, salmon) and one special uses dashi; no vegan curry is named (2026 reviews).
kyoto_spice_gate_teramachi.hours_raw: Breakfast 7:30–11:00 (last order); lunch to dinner 11:30–21:00 (last order); Thursday 11:30–15:00 only after breakfast; no regular closing day; spices can be bought at any time (official site). Tabelog adds that curry is served through the café hours and that hours may change, announced on Instagram. No reservations (Tabelog). 22 seats (8 counter, 14 table); non-smoking; cards, IC cards and QR payments (Tabelog). Second floor, up a white spiral staircase (October 2026), on Teramachi south of Bukkoji; 5 min from Kawaramachi Stn; no bicycle parking (Tabelog). Opened 12 May 2022 (Tabelog).
kyoto_spice_gate_teramachi.notes: [Curry · Teramachi, a spice shop that serves curry from breakfast] Up a white spiral staircase on Teramachi, a "curry & spice select shop": shelves of spices to smell and buy (you can blend your own garam masala) and a counter serving spice curry on basmati rice from 7:30 in the morning. Regular curries run ¥1,300–1,500, with a monthly special such as a salmon rare-katsu curry (¥1,980 large) or a dashi curry katsu don; finish with a craft cola or a lemongrass sour. Most reviewers find the spicing aromatic rather than hot (the bone-in mutton curry has more kick). Listed on the same website as the biryani shop INDIA GATE. Open every day; Thursday until 15:00.

roles: Run alongside INDIA GATE (official site); no staff named
chef_bio.background: Per the official site: SPICE GATE grew from the wish to make spices feel closer to everyday life — a little spice added to Japanese food, home cooking or tea — with organic and unusual spices; it aims to be "the Village Vanguard of spices". chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: to suggest easy, everyday ways to use and buy spices.
chef_bio.specialty: Spice curry on basmati rice; monthly special curries.

anecdotes.text: A September 2026 visitor found the September dashi curry katsu don, topped with a mildly spicy sweet-vinegar sauce, a combination never met before and delicious to the last bite.
An October 2026 diner noted that the large size comes with 230 g of rice mixing basmati and Japonica, and judged the value modest.
An October 2026 breakfast visitor chose from three curries served with Thai rice and several side dishes.

kyoto_neze_sanjo_kiyamachi.gf_detail: Ask. Pasta is the heart of the menu (carbonara, capellini, bolognese), with baguette, gratin and croquette-style dishes; grilled pork, prosciutto and smoked chicken are also served; no gluten information (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_neze_sanjo_kiyamachi.vegan_detail: Ask. Most dishes use egg, cheese, ham, seafood or meat (the signature carbonara uses five egg yolks); seasonal vegetable pasta appears, but no vegan dish is named (2024–2026 reviews).
kyoto_neze_sanjo_kiyamachi.hours_raw: 18:00–23:00, Monday to Saturday; closed Sunday and irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations taken, same day possible (Tabelog; March 2026). Mostly à la carte; an omakase course with a reservation by the day before — ¥6,000 in one Tabelog note, "from ¥8,800" in another (Tabelog; July 2026). 16 seats (8 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; cards accepted (Tabelog). Third floor, the third building north of Sanjo on Kiyamachi; 3 min from Keihan Sanjo Stn (Tabelog; September 2026). Opened 20 August 2007 (Tabelog).
kyoto_neze_sanjo_kiyamachi.notes: [Italian · Sanjo Kiyamachi, a couple's third-floor trattoria] A sixteen-seat Italian on the third floor, three buildings up Kiyamachi from Sanjo, run since 2007 by chef Hiroshi Mori and the chef’s wife. The menu changes almost daily and is mostly à la carte: the must-order is the carbonara made with five Yamada Farm egg yolks and no cream; the cold sea-urchin capellini and the prosciutto you slice yourself on an Italian machine come close behind. Sit at the counter to talk with the chef. Around ¥8,000–15,000 a head with wine. Open 18:00–23:00, closed Sunday.

chef_bio.chef_name: Hiroshi Mori (romaji from Tabelog's introduction; the kanji is not in a source)

chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog's introduction: chef Hiroshi Mori previously worked at Santa Maria Novella Tisaneria; the menu changes almost daily, so tell the shop what you would like when booking. Tabelog gives the opening as 20 August 2007. Tabelog Italian WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2023 and 2025. The chef keeps a blog on Ameba (Tabelog).
chef_bio.specialty: Yamada Farm egg carbonara; sea-urchin capellini; self-sliced prosciutto.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 visitor who came for the carbonara was invited to slice prosciutto on the machine before the meal — a first, and "thin and fluffy".
A July 2026 diner at the counter learned from the chef that the green onions on the sea-urchin capellini come from one of the few Aichi farms still growing them in soil.
Two older first-timers in September 2026 found the owner curious about how the pair had found the place, and the owner’s wife recommended the wine.
"It's a go-to spot when I want to drink a little more or enjoy a delicious pasta dish to wrap up the night." — May 2026.

kyoto_kyo_no_musubime.gf_detail: Ask. Obanzai and izakaya plates seasoned with dashi, soy sauce and miso, plus spring rolls and fried chicken wings; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_musubime.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the menu centres on fish, sea urchin, chicken and seasonal obanzai, and no vegan dish is named (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_no_musubime.hours_raw: 17:00–24:00 (last order 23:30), every day; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Reservations accepted, confirmed by a call from the shop; booking recommended (July 2026), though walk-ins at opening and later have found seats (July and November 2026). Fresh sea urchin "at cost" needs a reservation (Tabelog). Courses for groups: 7 dishes ¥4,400 (3–16 people) or 9 dishes ¥5,500 (2–16) (Tabelog). A ¥330 charge per person (Tabelog, original text "330"). 20 seats at a counter and a few tables (25 standing); smoking allowed (Tabelog; February 2026). Cards, QUICPay, PayPay and Alipay (Tabelog). English menu (Tabelog). Ground floor of ランブラス館, just off Kiyamachi; 7 min walk from Gion-Shijo (Keihan) and Kawaramachi (Hankyu) stations (Tabelog; July 2026). Opened 15 June 2015 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_no_musubime.notes: [Obanzai izakaya · Kiyamachi, Kyoto home cooking late] A small counter izakaya just off Kiyamachi, open until midnight, where an open kitchen turns out Kyoto obanzai — eggplant ohitashi, potato salad — and seasonal plates: hamo sashimi in summer, scallop potato salad, mentaiko chicken wings, Saikyo-miso spring rolls, and an egg rice to finish. Local sake, with a deep list of Tamagawa. Reviewers single out friendly, attentive staff who explain the dishes and suggest sake off the list. Courses ¥4,400–5,500 for groups; book ahead. Smoking allowed.

roles: Owner and kitchen staff (unnamed in the sources)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a home-style Kyoto izakaya of seasonal ingredients and local produce, Kyoto vegetables and fish, with an open kitchen visible from every seat; courses use ingredients chosen by the owner. Opened 15 June 2015 (Tabelog). A July 2026 reviewer found two women working in the kitchen; reviewers in 2026 describe staff who explain the ingredients and recommend sake not on the menu.

kyoto_kyo_hyoka_atenaru_mono.gf_detail: Ask. Shaved ice of pure ice with homemade syrups and toppings such as dried fruit, sweet-potato dumplings and chips, and condensed-milk ice; no ingredient or gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_hyoka_atenaru_mono.vegan_detail: Ask. Some kakigori use condensed milk or cheese; fruit syrups and the four "refreshing drinks" may suit, but ingredients are not published (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews).
kyoto_kyo_hyoka_atenaru_mono.hours_raw: Seasonal: the 2026 season ran 29 April to 30 September, Wednesday to Sunday 13:00–20:30 (last order 20:00), closed Monday and Tuesday (Tabelog). A reviewer had yudofu and sake here in February 2026, so there may be winter service, but no off-season hours are published. Reservations accepted (Tabelog; August 2026). One order per person; tables are shared (Tabelog). 14 places: two tables for four and a standing counter for six (Tabelog). All seats face the Kamo River (October 2025). Cards, e-money and most QR payments (Tabelog). English menu with photos; children and strollers welcome (Tabelog). At the back of a leather goods shop (ノーノーイエス京都店); 5 min walk from Gion-Shijo Stn exit 1 and Kyoto-Kawaramachi Stn exit 1B (Tabelog; 2025–2026 reviews). Opened 15 May 2024 (Tabelog).
kyoto_kyo_hyoka_atenaru_mono.notes: [Kakigori · Shijo Kamo River, a summer counter behind a leather shop] Walk through a leather goods shop south of Shijo to find a bar-like room where every seat looks over the Kamo River: summer kakigori of pure natural ice, shaved fluffy and dressed with homemade syrups in unusual pairings — Kyoto sweet potato with dumplings, peach with pink grapefruit, even tomato, cheese and basil — about ¥2,000 each and big enough to share. You get a leather coaster with your order. Seasonal: 2026 ran from late April to the end of September, Wednesday to Sunday from 13:00.

roles: Staff of the leather shop’s café (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: Per the Tabelog shop text: a stylish hideaway with an open view of the Kamo River, fluffy shaved ice of pure ice made from natural ice, four refreshing drinks and seasonal drinks with homemade syrups. An August 2025 reviewer understood the shop to sell leather goods and serve kakigori only in summer; a February 2026 reviewer was served yudofu and sake there.

kyoto_bel_amer_kyoto_bettei.vegan_detail: Ask. Many chocolates and desserts use milk, white chocolate, cream or custard; ingredients for individual chocolates are not listed on the shop pages read (official site; 2026 reviews).

kyoto_bel_amer_kyoto_bettei.notes: [Chocolate & café · Sanjo, chocolate in a hundred-year-old townhouse] The Sanjo main shop of Bel Amer Kyoto Bettei, a Kyoto chocolate brand born from Chocolat Bel Amer, in a townhouse over a century old with a small garden: downstairs, jewel-like bonbons, stick chocolates and Mizuho no Shizuku — masu-shaped chocolates filled with sake or tea jelly; upstairs, the Chocolat Bar overlooking Sanjo-dori serves plated desserts like a smoked fondant chocolat (¥1,540), parfaits, a chocolate curry and afternoon tea (¥7,150, the only thing you can book). 10:00–20:00. Tabelog Sweets WEST 100 2026.

roles: Chocolatiers of Bel Amer Kyoto Bettei (no one is named)

chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: chocolate that represents Japan and connects it to the world, made one piece at a time.
chef_bio.specialty: Mizuho no Shizuku; stick chocolates; plated desserts.

kyoto_sosaku_chuka_ichino_funairi.gf_detail: Ask. Chinese courses with soy- and Shaoxing-seasoned braises, fermented black bean sauce, spring rolls, fried dishes and fried rice; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sosaku_chuka_ichino_funairi.vegan_detail: Not vegan: courses are built on shark fin, seafood, chicken and duck in stocks (Tabelog; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_sosaku_chuka_ichino_funairi.hours_raw: Monday to Saturday 11:30–14:30 (last order 13:00) and 17:30–22:00 (last order 20:30); closed Sunday (Tabelog). Courses only, by reservation; parties of 9 or more by phone, best called 15:00–17:00 (Tabelog). 10% service charge, no cover charge (Tabelog). 32 seats and seven private rooms for 2 to 20, some tatami or sunken; non-smoking (Tabelog). Children from elementary school age (Tabelog). Cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR (Tabelog). In a townhouse facing the Ichinofunairi canal off Kawaramachi Nijo; 2 min walk from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_sosaku_chuka_ichino_funairi.notes: [Chinese · Kawaramachi Nijo, Chef Wei's townhouse by the canal] Creative Chinese cooking in a century-old townhouse facing the old Ichinofunairi boat landing on the Takase River, with private rooms: Chef Wei blends the eight Chinese cuisines with Japanese and Western techniques and Kyoto produce, on the principle that food is medicine. The braised shark fin is the signature; light, ungreasy courses run from appetiser platters to fried rice and a huge mango shaved ice. Lunch around ¥6,000–8,000; dinner courses ¥11,000–14,850, plus 10%. Book a course; closed Sunday. Tabelog Chinese WEST 100 2021, 2024.

roles: Owner-chef (reviews: "Chef Wei"; "The owner-chef trained at Banchinro")
chef_bio.background: Per an August 2026 review: founded in 1996 in a renovated 100-year-old townhouse that was once a tea shop facing the historic Ichinofunairi; the owner-chef trained at Banchinro in Yokohama Chinatown and holds a special chef qualification from China; organic vegetables, especially Kyoto vegetables, from contracted farms. The Tabelog shop text calls the chef Michelin-starred and the restaurant featured in the Michelin Guide; a September 2026 review says it "previously earned a Michelin star". A September 2026 regular mentions Chef Wei’s television appearances; another saw the chef greet every room at the start and end of the meal. Sister shops listed on Tabelog: Gohan Iido Sanjo (a Chinese diner known for soup dumplings) and Gohan Gyoza (gyoza and Taiwanese food near Karasuma Oike). Tabelog Chinese WEST "Tabelog 100" 2021, 2024.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the Tabelog shop text: "Ishoku-Dogen" — food and medicine are one; delicious, health-conscious dishes.
chef_bio.specialty: Braised shark fin; shark fin soup.

anecdotes.text: "Chef Wei made a point to visit each room to greet guests both at the beginning and end of the meal" — September 2026.
"For dessert, I had mango shaved ice, which was a pleasant surprise." — September 2026.
"Overall, the flavors felt a bit on the lighter side. Surprisingly, I ended up quite full" — October 2026.
"The private room allowed us to relax, and the view of the Takase River from the window was charming." — August 2026.

kyoto_oryori_miyama.gf_detail: Ask. Game dishes come with soy-based sauces and dashi; pheasant kara-age, a pheasant katsu sandwich, spring rolls and ramen are wheat-based; no gluten information (2026 reviews).
kyoto_oryori_miyama.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a game-meat bar (venison, wild boar, pheasant, bear), with dashi-based small dishes and egg-and-mayonnaise starters (2026 reviews).
kyoto_oryori_miyama.hours_raw: 15:00–23:00 daily; closed irregularly (Tabelog). Ground floor: a standing bar for up to about 20 (Tabelog); standing spots can be booked only on the day (June 2026). Upstairs: rooms for 2–8 by reservation only, for the bear hot-pot and pheasant sukiyaki courses (Tabelog). Table charge ¥330 (Tabelog); a small starter such as a pickled egg with spiced mayonnaise is served (2026 reviews). Non-smoking; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay (Tabelog). On Nishikiyamachi along the Takase River, within 5 min of Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn (Tabelog; October 2026).
kyoto_oryori_miyama.notes: [Game standing bar · Kawaramachi, bear and pheasant by the plate] The casual second shop of Gion's Gibier MIYAMA, on the Takase River: a calm, stylish standing bar downstairs where small plates of game from Miyama — venison tartare and roast, bear pâté, wild-boar spring rolls, pheasant tsukune tofu (¥800) — go with homemade umeshu or shiso liqueur, and booked rooms upstairs for bear hot pot (¥22,000) or pheasant sukiyaki (¥16,500). Reviewers note the meat has little gamey taste. ¥330 table charge. Open daily 15:00–23:00.

roles: Chef of Gibier MIYAMA and this shop (Tabelog, shop text)
chef_bio.background: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): the second location of Gibier MIYAMA in Gion, offering its game in a more casual setting; game comes from the nature-rich town of Miyama; the owner-chef won the Bronze Egg award at RED U-35, and the shop text names "Chef Futa Kanda". An August 2026 reviewer notes that Gibier MIYAMA itself does not take reservations. An October 2026 reviewer took the concept to be introducing game meat to people not used to it.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per Tabelog (the shop’s own text): "The charm of a surprisingly mild flavor."
chef_bio.specialty: Venison tartare; pheasant tsukune tofu; bear hot pot.

anecdotes.text: "I ordered the roasted venison and bear pâté, both of which had no unpleasant odors and were easy to eat." — June 2026.
"The cheerful hospitality from the owner made for a wonderfully comfortable atmosphere." — October 2026.
A July 2026 reviewer spent ¥7,810 on venison and three drinks, against a Tabelog budget of about ¥3,000, and found the prices slightly high for the area but the food excellent.

kyoto_shu_shuz.gf_detail: Ask. Sushi with soy sauce and marinated fish, simmered dishes, meat dishes and burger-like snacks; ingredients change daily and no gluten information is published (Tabelog; 2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_shu_shuz.vegan_detail: Not vegan: a sushi and fish izakaya; the starters have included sushi egg (2024–26 reviews).
kyoto_shu_shuz.hours_raw: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday 17:30–23:00; Friday 17:15–24:00; Saturday 17:15–1:00; Sunday 17:15–23:00; closed Wednesday (Tabelog). Reservations recommended, as early as possible: ingredients and the menu change daily, orders stop when ingredients run out, and specific requests can be prepared if asked in advance (Tabelog); a February 2026 diner booked a week ahead and found it nearly full. Groups of 1–4 only (Tabelog). Charge of ¥500 per person (おひとり様¥500, Tabelog). Smoking allowed at the tables (Tabelog; June 2026). Cash only (Tabelog; November 2025). 20 seats (6 at the counter, 14 at tables) (Tabelog). In a narrow alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho north of Shijo — hard to find; enter from the main street (March 2025); 3 min from Kyoto Kawaramachi Stn Exits 1 and 2 (Tabelog).
kyoto_shu_shuz.notes: [Sushi izakaya · Kiyamachi, a hidden alley counter] A 20-seat sushi izakaya tucked into a narrow alley between Kiyamachi and Pontocho, run by a couple, with nostalgic anime stickers on one wall. Sushi on red-and-white-vinegar rice comes by the piece or as six- and ten-piece sets, alongside small dishes such as oyster namero and kimchi lotus root, meat dishes, and sake from around Japan; ingredients change daily, so book early and ask for favourites in advance. Service can be slow when busy. Smoking allowed; ¥500 charge each; cash only. Late on Friday and Saturday; closed Wednesday.

roles: Owner and the owner’s wife, per a February 2026 review (unnamed)
chef_bio.background: A February 2026 reviewer says the shop is run by the owner and the owner’s wife, who warned in advance that service would take time when busy; another February 2026 reviewer describes some nigiri handed straight from the chef’s hand and a wall of nostalgic anime stickers. An October 2024 reviewer mentions travelers toasting with the owner over sake.
chef_bio.specialty: Sushi by the piece; oyster namero.

anecdotes.text: A February 2026 diner found the couple running the shop very busy and the service a little slow, as the shop had warned beforehand.
"The entrance is a bit hard to find! It’s easier to enter from the main street!" — March 2025.
An October 2024 diner liked the sushi but would rather the smoke stayed away from it.

kyoto_matsuya_tokiwa.gf_detail: Not gluten-free: miso matsukaze is made from wheat flour, sugar, white miso and sesame (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matsuya_tokiwa.vegan_detail: Ask. Reviewers list only wheat flour, sugar, white (Saikyo) miso and sesame, and one notes it is egg-free; the shop publishes no ingredient list (2026 reviews).
kyoto_matsuya_tokiwa.hours_raw: 9:30–15:00 daily; hours may change (Tabelog). Takeaway only (Tabelog). The miso matsukaze is best reserved: the large (¥1,200) needs booking by the day before; the small (¥1,000) is sold on the day in limited numbers (Tabelog). Walk-ins often find one to three left, or none (2026 reviews); cut ends for home use (¥300) are sometimes available and can be prepared if you call ahead (June, September, October 2026). Keeps about three days; the miso top sticks, so do not wrap it in plastic (July 2026). Cash only (Tabelog). Parking for one or two cars at the shop (Tabelog). On Sakaimachi-dori south of Marutamachi, below the Imperial Palace’s Sakaimachi gate; 5 min walk from Marutamachi Stn (Tabelog; September 2026).
kyoto_matsuya_tokiwa.notes: [Wagashi · Imperial Palace, one sweet for centuries] A noren-hung shop south of the Imperial Palace's Sakaimachi gate that sells one thing: miso matsukaze, a moist, castella-like cake of flour, sugar, white Saikyo miso and sesame — one of Kyoto's three famous matsukaze, per a reviewer. Reviewers in 2026 were greeted by an elderly lady in the small tatami-floored shop. Book a day ahead (large ¥1,200; small ¥1,000, a few sold on the day), or ask for the ¥300 bag of cut ends. Eat within about three days. Daily 9:30–15:00, cash only.

roles: Family shop; no one is named in the sources

Reviewers describe an elderly woman, apparently the head of the shop, with a young male staff member in the small tatami-floored shop. A July 2026 reviewer calls it one of Kyoto’s three famous matsukaze shops. Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026.

kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga.gf_detail: Ask. Oike senbei tastes of egg and wheat (August 2026); bean-paste sweets, yokan and kudzu sweets may be wheat-free, but no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga.vegan_detail: Ask. Yokan and bean-paste sweets are plant-based in principle, but the Oike senbei contains egg and Honohono is a baked sweet; no ingredient lists are published (2026 reviews).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga.hours_raw: 8:00–18:00; closed Wednesday and Sunday (Tabelog). A reviewer found it open on Sunday 1 November 2026 at about 8:00, against Tabelog’s Sunday closure — check before going. Takeaway only. Reservations taken (Tabelog). Cards not accepted; e-money accepted (Tabelog). At the south-west corner of Teramachi and Oike, diagonally opposite Honnoji; 151 m from Kyoto Shiyakusho-mae Stn (Tabelog; MAPPLE; September 2026).
kyoto_kameya_yoshinaga.notes: [Wagashi · Teramachi Oike, Oike senbei] A long-established wagashi house on the corner of Teramachi and Oike, opposite Honnoji, best known for Oike senbei — pale, sugar-glazed wafers that dissolve like snow (¥1,350 for a tin of 22, per MAPPLE). The shelves also hold Tsuki, modelled on the door pulls of Katsura Imperial Villa, 小倉山 yokan and seasonal sweets, such as Daimonji-themed ones in August. One reviewer found the senbei has grown pricey. Takeaway only. 8:00–18:00; Tabelog says closed Wednesday and Sunday, but a reviewer found it open on a Sunday in November 2026.

roles: Long-established wagashi house; no one is named in the sources
chef_bio.background: MAPPLE gives the founding as 1832 (天保3); an August 2026 reviewer says it has been around since 1803. MAPPLE lists Oike senbei, Tsuki (after the door pulls of Katsura Imperial Villa) and 小倉山 yokan. A July 2026 reviewer who has loved the senbei since childhood found it has become quite pricey and that a favourite seasonal sweet, Toki no Nagare, is no longer made. Tabelog Japanese sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023, 2026.
chef_bio.specialty: Oike senbei; Tsuki.

anecdotes.text: "Instead of being hard and crunchy, they dissolve almost instantly in your mouth, reminiscent of cotton candy." — August 2026.
A September 2026 visitor was given a taste of a miso version of the senbei.
"Tabelog says they are closed on Sundays, but I visited on November 1, which was a Sunday." — November 2026.

kyoto_hoshoan_pontocho.gf_detail: Ask. Courses run through yuba, yudofu, sashimi with dashi soy sauce, hamo shabu with plum sauce, lava-stone grilled meat with house soy sauce, and sukiyaki in winter; no gluten information (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hoshoan_pontocho.vegan_detail: Not vegan in practice: the courses centre on black wagyu, hamo, lobster, abalone and sashimi, with sukiyaki in winter (Tabelog; 2025–26 reviews).
kyoto_hoshoan_pontocho.hours_raw: 17:00–23:00 (last order 22:00), Tuesday to Sunday; closed Monday, and Tuesday may close after a Monday holiday (Tabelog). Kawadoko terrace over the Kamo River from May to the end of September (Tabelog). Book by phone or Tabelog; tell changes by the day before; 100% charge for cancellations on the day before or the day (Tabelog). Each guest orders at least one dish and one drink (Tabelog). 20 table seats; private hire for 20; non-smoking; free Wi-Fi; cards accepted (Tabelog). Back of the first floor of 紫光会館 on Pontocho, north of Shijo; 3 min from Kawaramachi or Gion-Shijo Stn (Tabelog).
kyoto_hoshoan_pontocho.notes: [Wagyu & Kyoto courses · Pontocho, on the Kamo River] A restaurant at the back of a Pontocho building that looks over the Kamo River toward Higashiyama and the Minamiza theatre, with a riverside kawadoko terrace from May to September. Courses pair Kyoto starters — yuba, yudofu, hamo shabu — with lobster, abalone and black wagyu grilled on Fuji lava stones (about ¥9,500); in winter, wagyu sukiyaki (¥7,000 set). Reviews range from delighted to disappointed. 17:00–23:00, closed Monday.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources

kyoto_washoku_haru.notes: [Washoku · near Shijo-Karasuma, an eleven-seat counter] A small counter on a back lane by Bukkoji, opened in 2015 by an owner who trained at Wakuden, serving refined Japanese cooking as à la carte plates to go with sake: the famous unmashed potato salad, conger-eel sashimi, duck menchi katsu, sea-bream sansho mochi, crab salt yakisoba and saba sushi to finish. kyoto_kuriya.gf_detail: Ask. Many sweets are chestnut, sugar, mochi rice and bean paste (Kin no Mi, kuri ohagi, chestnut yokan), but the range also has chestnut dorayaki, monaka and senbei; no ingredient list is published (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuriya.vegan_detail: Ask. Candied chestnuts, kuri ohagi and yokan are described as chestnut, sugar and rice, but no ingredient list is published and the dorayaki batter is not described (official site; 2026 reviews).
kyoto_kuriya.hours_raw: Tuesday–Saturday 9:00–18:00, Sundays and public holidays 10:00–15:00; closed Monday (next day if Monday is a holiday) and New Year’s Day; hours may change (official site). Takeaway only, no seats (Tabelog). Orders can be reserved up to the day before (Tabelog); kuri ohagi is seasonal (autumn) and sells out, and a reviewer was told it is not made on some weekdays — reserve by phone (2026 reviews). Parking ticket for purchases of ¥2,500 or more at くるっとパーク大文字町 (official site). Cards, e-money and PayPay (Tabelog). 2 min from the Horikawa-Marutamachi bus stop, 8 min from Marutamachi Stn (official site).
kyoto_kuriya.notes: [Wagashi · Horikawa-Marutamachi, all about chestnuts] A small chestnut-sweets shop near the prefectural office whose wooden sign announces its signature, Kin no Mi — whole chestnuts glazed in a crisp sugar shell and wrapped in gold (about ¥260 each). In autumn the queue forms for kuri ohagi, sticky rice wrapped in Tanba-chestnut paste (about ¥320), which sells out: phone a day ahead. Also chestnut dorayaki and yokan. Takeaway only; cards accepted; closed Monday.

roles: Operator unnamed in the sources
chef_bio.background: Per an October 2026 review: a chestnut-sweets specialist established in the Taisho era, using carefully selected domestic chestnuts. Tabelog Japanese-sweets WEST "Tabelog 100" 2023 and 2026.
chef_bio.philosophy: Per the official site: "当店の菓子は京菓子のような華やかさは無いかもしれませんが、故郷を思い出して頂ける素朴な菓子です" — not the showiness of Kyoto confections, but simple sweets that remind people of home, made with care for natural flavour.
chef_bio.specialty: Kin no Mi; kuri ohagi.

kyoto_yakitori_seisakujo.notes: [Yakitori · Shijo Kawaramachi, Kyo Akajidori over binchotan] A retro-modern yakitori izakaya down a narrow "eel's bed" building a couple of minutes from Kawaramachi Stn, using only female Kyo Akajidori chickens grilled over binchotan and salted with Guérande salt. Courses with all-you-can-drink from ¥4,000. Open to midnight, to 1:00 on Friday and Saturday; ¥330 service charge.
